kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl credential-submit-intl --product-code CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION --scene-code 1230000123 --merchant-biz-id e0c34a000353888 --doc-type 02 --ocr-area 0201 --fraud-check false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CredentialSubmitIntl

parameters.help_en: The product solution to use. Set this to CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The custom authentication scenario ID. You can use this ID to query related records in the console. The value can be a combination of letters, numbers, or underscores with a maximum length of 10 characters
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business identifier, used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can be a combination of letters and numbers with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. If you use this method to submit a photo, check the photo size and do not submit an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 图片Base64编码。如果您选择此方式传入照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The credential type. Valid values:
02: vehicle registration certificate
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型：
02：车辆登记证明
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The extraction type. Valid values:

0201: Thailand vehicle registration certificate
parameters.help_zh:
提取类型：

0201：泰国车辆登记证明
parameters.name: ocr_area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable tampering detection. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启篡改检测
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: fraud_check

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable quality detection. Valid values:
Y: Enabled.
N: Disabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启质量检测 Y: 开启, N: 关闭
parameters.name: id_quality

parameters.help_en: The field validation rule configuration in JSON string format
parameters.help_zh: 字段校验规则配置，JSON字符串
parameters.name: check_rule_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable OCR result standardization. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启OCR结果标准化 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable translation. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启翻译 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_translation

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the authentication request
